title: createTable creates the SQLite sink table from the model, and a re-run upserts into it
proves: the project has no DDL file and no sqlite3 step: the first run creates journal_lines from the fields of the generate; createTable="true" is the consent and the <id> element line_id is the primary key
a second run finds the table, its columns and primary key match, and the upsert writes the same 6 rows again without an error
type= on a key sets the column type, so a key whose values are all null still gets a column; the other columns take the type of their first value
Build creates no table: it shows the planned CREATE TABLE in planned_operations and proves the rows only; it derives a unique check on the single <id> field (the acceptance declares none)

each rejected class stops Build: no <id> element, no database target, createTable on a clear, createTable on a nested generate, a value that is no boolean, an all-null column without type= and a value type without a column type
a table that lacks a written column or has another primary key is never altered: the run stops with I930 and names the difference (Build connects to no database, so only the run sees the table)
a field that first appears after the first page is not dropped silently: the run stops with I930 (Build rejects it on its captured rows)
createTable is limited to sqlite and postgresql, and to plain, upsert targets: mysql, mssql, oracle and an update target are rejected with I929
createTable="false" creates nothing: the run then fails on the missing table

patch.new:
<generate name="splits" count="1" target="ledger.upsert" createTable="true"><id name="split_id" constant="1"/></generate>
    </generate>

patch.old:
createTable="true">
        <!-- <id> marks the primary-key column; every other field is a <key> -->
        <id name="line_id" generator="IncrementGenerator"/>
patch.new:
createTable="true" pageSize="3">
        <!-- <id> marks the primary-key column; every other field is a <key> -->
        <id name="line_id" generator="IncrementGenerator"/>
        <key name="note" script="'late'" condition="line_id > 3"/>

<generate name="again" count="1" target="ledger.upsert" targetEntity="journal_lines" createTable="true">
        <id name="line_id" constant="99"/>
        <key name="region" constant="EU"/>
    </generate>
</setup>
